svg.title: The files BMad writes, who writes them, and where they land
svg.desc: Left, the folder hierarchy of a project using BMad, with default paths from _bmad/config.toml. The project root holds AGENTS.md, whose context block bmad-project-context writes (Mary); the installed skills under .claude/skills or .agents/skills; _bmad with config.toml, custom overrides, scripts, method, toolbox and render; _bmad-output; docs as project knowledge; and tests written by bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests (Amelia). _bmad-output holds brainstorming runs (Mary), forge runs and specs/spec-slug folders with SPEC.md, stories.yaml and stories (no agent), and party-mode. planning-artifacts holds research, briefs and the PRFAQ (Mary), prds (John), ux-designs (Sally), architecture (Winston), epics.md (John), implementation-readiness.md (John or Winston) and sprint-change proposals (John). implementation-artifacts holds sprint-status.yaml (John, Winston or Amelia), and story files spec-slug.md, epic context, deferred work, epic retrospectives and the test summary (Amelia). Right, the top-level sections of the key files: AGENTS.md context block; brief.md; prd.md; DESIGN.md and EXPERIENCE.md; ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md; epics.md; sprint-status.yaml keys; SPEC.md and stories.yaml; the Build story file; and the epic retrospective.

g.text: What each agent writes, where it lands, and what is inside. Paths are the defaults.
Executive Summary · The Problem · The Solution
What Makes This Different · Who This Serves · Success Criteria · Scope · Vision
Purpose · Vision · Target User · Glossary · Features (FR-n)
Non-Goals · MVP Scope · Success Metrics · Open Questions · Assumptions
DESIGN.md is the look; EXPERIENCE.md is the behaviour:
Foundation · Information Architecture · Voice and Tone · Components
State Patterns · Interaction Primitives · Accessibility Floor · Key Flows
Design Paradigm · Inherited Invariants · Invariants & Rules (AD-n)
Overview · Requirements Inventory (FR, NFR, UX, coverage map)
Epic List · ## Epic N · ### Story N.M
Why · Capabilities · Constraints · Non-goals · Success signal
Assumptions · Open Questions; companions such as brownfield.md
stories.yaml: id · title · description · checkpoints · invoke_dev_with
story file, one per Build run
Intent · Boundaries & Constraints · I/O & Edge-Case Matrix · Code Map
Tasks & Acceptance · Implementation Notes · Spec Change Log
Review Triage Log · Design Notes · Verification
or RETROSPECTIVE.md in a spec folder
Epic summary · Findings · Behavior verification · Previous-retro follow-through
Action items · Acceptance verdict · Open questions · Assumptions
